announcement.title: GLM-5.3
announcement.quote: GLM-5.3 uses the same base model as GLM-5.2 — every gain comes from post-training.

source.note: Row order: GLM-5.3, GLM-5.2, Kimi K3, DeepSeek-V4 Pro-0813, Qwen3.8-Max, Opus 4.8, Fable 5 (w/ fallback), GPT-5.6 Sol.

releases.notes: GLM-5.3 is a post-training-only update on the GLM-5.2 base model; the launch post re-reports only coding/agentic/cyber benchmarks and HLE-with-tools, not the general reasoning basket (GPQA, plain HLE, AIME).
